name: sync
doc:
sync: synchronization beyond task's Mutex, WaitGroup and
Channel: RwMutex (async), Semaphore (async), Barrier (async), Once,
AtomicInt / AtomicBool (lock-free, runtime/src/std_sync.c), Atomic<T>
(any comparable value) and Pool<T>. The async primitives are built like
task.Mutex: a per-object spin lock held for a few statements and waker
tasks fired in FIFO order; nothing blocks a worker thread.

items.name: Atomic
items.doc:
An atomic cell for any comparable value (pointers, strings, ...),
guarded by a spin lock; use AtomicInt/AtomicBool for lock-free ints.
items.summary: An atomic cell for any comparable value (pointers, strings, ...), guarded by a spin lock; use AtomicInt/AtomicBool for lock-free ints.

items.name: Barrier
items.doc:
A reusable barrier for n tasks: `await b.Wait()` returns when n tasks
are waiting; then the barrier resets for the next round. Wait yields
true in exactly one task per round (the last to arrive).
items.summary: A reusable barrier for n tasks: `await b.Wait()` returns when n tasks are waiting; then the barrier resets for the next round.

members.doc: A barrier for n (> 0) parties.
members.summary: A barrier for n (> 0) parties.

members.doc: Wait waits until n tasks are waiting; true in the last task to arrive.
members.summary: Wait waits until n tasks are waiting; true in the last task to arrive.

items.name: Once
items.doc:
Runs a function once (Go's sync.Once); concurrent callers wait (spin
with thread yields) until the first call finished.
items.summary: Runs a function once (Go's sync.Once); concurrent callers wait (spin with thread yields) until the first call finished.

members.doc: Do calls f if no call of Do has run yet on this Once.
members.summary: Do calls f if no call of Do has run yet on this Once.

members.doc: Done reports whether f has finished.
members.summary: Done reports whether f has finished.

items.name: Pool
items.doc:
A free list of reusable values (Go's sync.Pool, without GC-driven
clearing): Get returns a pooled value or a new one from New.
items.summary: A free list of reusable values (Go's sync.Pool, without GC-driven clearing): Get returns a pooled value or a new one from New.

members.name: New
members.signature: static func New(newFn func() T) Pool<T>
members.doc: A pool creating values with newFn, keeping at most 64 idle values.
members.summary: A pool creating values with newFn, keeping at most 64 idle values.

members.name: Get
members.doc: Get returns a pooled value, or a new one from newFn (the zero value without one).
members.summary: Get returns a pooled value, or a new one from newFn (the zero value without one).

members.name: Put
members.doc: Put returns x to the pool (dropped when 64 are already idle).
members.summary: Put returns x to the pool (dropped when 64 are already idle).

members.doc: Idle values held.
members.summary: Idle values held.

items.name: RwMutex
items.doc:
A reader/writer lock: many readers or one writer. Writers are
preferred: once a writer waits, new readers queue behind it.
items.summary: A reader/writer lock: many readers or one writer.

members.name: RLock
members.doc: Waits for shared (read) access.
members.summary: Waits for shared (read) access.

members.name: TryRLock
members.doc: TryRLock takes read access without waiting; false if a writer holds or waits for the lock.
members.summary: TryRLock takes read access without waiting; false if a writer holds or waits for the lock.

members.name: RUnlock
members.doc: RUnlock releases read access; it panics without a matching RLock.
members.summary: RUnlock releases read access; it panics without a matching RLock.

members.name: Lock
members.doc: Waits for exclusive (write) access.
members.summary: Waits for exclusive (write) access.

members.name: TryLock
members.doc: TryLock takes write access without waiting; false if the lock is held.
members.summary: TryLock takes write access without waiting; false if the lock is held.

members.name: Unlock
members.doc: Unlock releases write access, waking the next writer or the waiting readers; it panics if not locked.
members.summary: Unlock releases write access, waking the next writer or the waiting readers; it panics if not locked.

items.name: Semaphore
items.doc: A counting semaphore: at most n holders at a time.
items.summary: A counting semaphore: at most n holders at a time.
